brandIdentity.designSummary:
**Cinematic Scroll: A Luxury Property Launch Film**

The Vision: We are crafting a premium, scroll-driven landing page that feels like a luxury property launch film and a high-trust real estate investment presentation. The design will evoke a sense of calm confidence and Grade-A quality, reflecting the asset's prime location in East Bangalore. The experience will be cinematic, minimal, and investment-grade, avoiding the typical real estate website aesthetic.

**Execution Blueprint:**
1. Full-Screen Immersive Sections: Each section will occupy the full viewport height (100vh) to create a cinematic, immersive experience.
2. Scroll-Triggered Animations: Smooth, ease-in-out cubic animations (0.8s-1.2s) will be used throughout the site, with foreground elements moving faster than the background to create depth and parallax effects.
3. Metallic Royal Gold Accents: A metallic/brushed gold finish will be used sparingly for emphasis, particularly in the logo, dividers, and interactive elements.
4. Elegant Typography: A luxury serif font will be used for headings, paired with a clean sans-serif font for body text, with generous line spacing and a breathable layout.
5. Loader Sequence: A custom loader will feature the gold 'M' monogram, a drawing gold wave line, and a cross-fade/zoom-out transition into the hero section, with scroll locked until complete.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Metallic royal gold is used sparingly for accents and interactive elements. Deep charcoal black is the dominant background color. Pearl ivory is used for headings and contrast. Champagne beige is used for soft section backgrounds. Muted forest green is used for nature cues.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: Ensure sufficient contrast between text and background colors, especially when using gold accents. WCAG AA compliance is a priority.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use for all main titles and section headings. Maintain a consistent hierarchy and generous line spacing.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Ensure sufficient contrast with background colors. Use semantic heading tags (H1-H6) for proper structure.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use for all body text and supporting information. Maintain a clean and readable style with adequate line height and letter spacing.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Ensure sufficient contrast with background colors. Use appropriate font sizes for readability.

layoutDna.complexitySpectrum: Minimal, with a focus on clarity and simplicity

brandIdentity.designSummary: The design features a warm, earthy color palette with soft cream, pale greenish-beige, and deep brown tones that create a natural and elegant atmosphere. Typography plays a central role, with large, classic serif fonts for headings that convey craftsmanship and luxury, paired with clean serif body text for readability. The layout is spacious and balanced, using generous white space and a column-based grid with subtle asymmetry to maintain visual interest. UI components like buttons and containers are minimal and understated, emphasizing simplicity and elegance. The overall aesthetic is timeless and artisanal, suitable for brands that value natural materials and refined presentation.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Sophisticated, warm, artisanal, and refined with a calm and inviting personality.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Use the 'background' color as the primary page background to create a soft, warm canvas. The 'primary' color is ideal for headings, key text elements, and interactive text such as links and buttons, paired with 'primaryForeground' for contrast on dark backgrounds like the footer. The 'secondary' color serves well for section backgrounds or subtle highlights, with 'secondaryForeground' used for text on these backgrounds to maintain readability. The 'footerBackground' anchors the page footer with a deep, rich tone, contrasting with 'primaryForeground' text for accessibility. The 'linkColor' and 'buttonBorder' colors are used for interactive elements, ensuring they stand out while maintaining the natural, elegant aesthetic. This palette supports a calm, sophisticated atmosphere with strong accessibility and visual harmony.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: The 'primaryForeground' on 'primary' and 'footerBackground' colors meet WCAG AA contrast standards for large and normal text, ensuring readability. The 'secondaryForeground' on 'secondary' also meets contrast requirements for body text. Links and buttons using 'linkColor' and 'buttonBorder' on 'background' or 'secondary' backgrounds maintain sufficient contrast for accessibility compliance.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use the 'bitter' font for all primary headings to convey sophistication and craftsmanship. Headings should be large, spaced with generous line height to enhance readability and elegance. Pair with body text fonts that are clean and legible to maintain hierarchy and balance. Use the 'primary' color for headings on light backgrounds and 'primaryForeground' on dark backgrounds to ensure contrast and accessibility.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Headings in 'primary' on 'background' and 'primaryForeground' on 'footerBackground' meet WCAG AA contrast standards for all sizes, ensuring clear readability.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use the 'bitter' font for body text to provide a clean, readable experience that complements the more decorative heading font. Maintain consistent line height and letter spacing for comfortable reading. Text color should be 'primary' on light backgrounds and 'primaryForeground' on dark backgrounds. Avoid overly small font sizes to preserve legibility, especially on mobile devices.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Body text in 'primary' on 'background' and 'primaryForeground' on 'footerBackground' meets WCAG AA contrast requirements for normal and large text.

welcomeSectionTypography.implementation: The welcome fold is divided into three distinct vertical panels of differing widths. The far left narrow column features strong branding or logo, often with a bold color background. The central, wider panel presents a powerful visual, such as a photo or artwork, serving as the primary focus. The far right column contains key information, such as event details and a call-to-action button. This layout creates a sophisticated, editorial look and striking asymmetry, drawing the eye to the image first, then to key actions and branding.

graphicElements.stickers: No stickers or badges are used, preserving the clean and sophisticated aesthetic.

brandIdentity.designSummary: This website design features a refined and minimal aesthetic with a vintage artisanal touch. The overall style is clean and spacious, using a very light cream background that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. Typography plays a central role, combining a classic serif font for headings and product titles with a monospace, typewriter-style font for body text, evoking authenticity and craftsmanship. The layout is grid-based and balanced, with generous white space that highlights product imagery and content blocks. Color usage is subtle and restrained, focusing on natural, muted tones such as soft blues and muted olive greens in content sections, contrasted with dark gray text for readability. UI elements like buttons are minimal and outlined with rounded corners, maintaining the delicate and understated feel. The design avoids heavy graphic elements, instead emphasizing clean lines, subtle borders, and natural product photography. This visual language conveys a calm, trustworthy, and sophisticated brand identity suitable for natural health, wellness, or boutique lifestyle brands.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Calm, trustworthy, refined, authentic, and approachable with a subtle vintage artisanal character.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Use the 'background' color as the primary canvas for all pages, providing a warm and inviting base. The 'primary' color is best suited for main text, headings, and key UI elements to ensure strong readability and contrast. The 'secondary' color can be used for accent blocks, subtle backgrounds, or secondary content areas to add natural warmth and depth. The 'softBlue' custom color is ideal for highlighting informational sections or subtle emphasis areas, creating a gentle contrast with the 'background'. Buttons and interactive elements should primarily use the 'primary' color for text and borders, maintaining clarity and accessibility. Combining 'primary' text on 'background' or 'softBlue' backgrounds ensures good contrast, while 'secondary' backgrounds with 'primary' text provide a natural, earthy feel. Avoid using heavy or saturated colors to maintain the calm and refined atmosphere. Overall, colors should be used sparingly and harmoniously to support the minimal and authentic brand tone.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: The 'primary' color on the 'background' color meets WCAG AA standards for normal text, ensuring readability and accessibility. The 'primary' color on 'softBlue' and 'secondary' backgrounds also meets WCAG AA contrast ratios for text and UI elements. Buttons using 'primary' text and borders on 'background' maintain sufficient contrast for accessibility. The palette avoids low-contrast combinations, supporting clear legibility across all text and interactive components.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use the heading font for all major titles, product names, and section headers to establish a refined and classic tone. Pair with the monospace paragraph font to create a distinctive contrast between headings and body text. Maintain generous spacing around headings to enhance readability and visual hierarchy. Use the 'primary' color for headings to ensure strong contrast against the 'background'. Avoid overly large sizes that disrupt the minimal balance.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Headings in the 'primary' color on the 'background' color meet WCAG AA contrast requirements, ensuring clear legibility for all users.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use the paragraph font for all body text, descriptions, and detailed content to convey an artisanal and authentic feel. The monospace style contrasts with the serif headings, enhancing the vintage character. Text should be set in the 'primary' color on the 'background' or 'softBlue' backgrounds for readability. Maintain consistent line height and letter spacing to avoid visual clutter. Avoid using this font for large headings or buttons to preserve hierarchy.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Paragraph text in the 'primary' color on the 'background' color meets WCAG AA standards for normal text, ensuring accessibility.

welcomeSectionTypography.implementation: The welcome section typography is anchored in the top third of the viewport, creating an immediate focal point upon page load. The large serif heading is prominently placed with generous spacing above and below, establishing a refined and elegant introduction. Supporting text uses the monospace font beneath the heading with ample line height and letter spacing to maintain clarity and balance. This placement leverages white space effectively, allowing the typography to breathe and set the tone for the rest of the site.

components.containers: Containers use soft background colors such as 'softBlue' and 'secondary' to differentiate content sections. They have subtle borders and consistent padding to maintain a clean and organized layout. The 'background' color is used for the main page canvas, ensuring content stands out clearly.
components.images: Product images are presented in a clean, uniform grid with no heavy framing or shadows, emphasizing natural lighting and product details. Images have generous spacing around them to avoid clutter and maintain focus.
components.buttons: Buttons are minimal and outlined with the 'primary' color as the border and text. They have rounded corners and a subtle hover effect implied by the design style. The 'background' color is used behind buttons to maintain contrast and clarity.

graphicElements.icons: Icons are minimal or absent, maintaining the clean and understated aesthetic. If used, they would likely be simple line icons in the 'primary' color to complement the typography and layout.
graphicElements.illustrations: No illustrations are present, reinforcing the focus on product photography and natural textures.
graphicElements.stickers: Badges such as 'SALE' and 'NEW' are small, rounded rectangles with a light background and 'primary' color text, maintaining subtle emphasis without overpowering the design.

brandIdentity.designSummary: This brand identity features a classic and authoritative visual style characterized by a strong serif typography paired with a patriotic color palette of deep navy blue, vivid red, and a warm cream background. The design employs a spacious, modular layout with generous negative space, allowing bold headlines and clear calls to action to stand out prominently. Navy blue serves as the primary color for text and backgrounds, conveying professionalism and trust, while red is used strategically for emphasis and interactive elements such as buttons and highlights, adding energy and urgency. The cream background softens the overall contrast, providing warmth and approachability. Typography is elegant and traditional, with large, bold serif headlines that communicate confidence and experience, complemented by smaller serif body text for readability and formality. UI components like buttons are distinctly styled with rounded corners and clear color differentiation between primary and secondary actions. Minimal graphic elements and purposeful iconography maintain a clean, focused aesthetic that supports the brand's serious and results-driven tone. This design language is versatile for any website requiring a professional, trustworthy, and engaging presence.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Authoritative, confident, professional, trustworthy, and results-driven.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Use the 'primary' color predominantly for large text blocks, backgrounds, and key UI elements to convey professionalism and trust. The 'primaryForeground' color should be used for text and icons placed on 'primary' backgrounds to ensure high contrast and readability. The 'secondary' color is reserved for calls to action, highlights, and interactive elements such as buttons to draw user attention and create urgency. Text or icons on 'secondary' backgrounds should use the 'secondaryForeground' color for optimal contrast. The 'background' color provides a warm, neutral canvas that balances the strong contrast between 'primary' and 'secondary' colors, supporting a clean and approachable aesthetic. Avoid mixing 'primary' and 'secondary' colors in large areas to maintain clarity. Use generous negative space around colored elements to enhance focus and legibility. This palette supports accessibility and visual hierarchy effectively.

The 'background' (#FFF8F0) provides sufficient contrast with both 'primary' and 'secondary' colors for body text and interface components, supporting readability and user comfort.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use the 'playfair display' font for all major headings and key textual statements to convey authority and elegance. Employ large font sizes with bold weight and italic styling for emphasis and hierarchy. Pair headings with smaller, simpler serif or sans-serif fonts for body text to maintain readability and balance. Ensure headings use the 'primary' color for maximum impact or 'primaryForeground' when placed on dark backgrounds. Maintain sufficient spacing above and below headings to enhance clarity and visual separation.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Headings in 'primary' color on 'background' or 'primaryForeground' on 'primary' backgrounds meet WCAG AA contrast standards, ensuring legibility for users with visual impairments.

initialPrompt: Create a single-page, premium, cinematic, scroll-driven landing page for a plotted development named MEENAKSHI PEARL. The site must feel like a luxury property launch film and a high-trust real estate investment presentation, with a calm, confident, Grade-A East Bangalore asset tone. It should not be a generic real estate website, but instead feel luxury, minimal, cinematic, and investment-grade. Strictly follow these brand and design rules: use only the provided Meenakshi Pearl logo with metallic/brushed gold finish (never flat yellow), never distort or recolor the logo, and place it in the loader, header, and footer. Color palette: metallic royal gold (accent only), deep charcoal black (dominant background), pearl ivory (headings & contrast), champagne beige (soft section backgrounds), muted forest green (nature cues). No bright or neon colors. Gold only for emphasis. Luxury spacing, calm contrast, soft shadows. Typography: elegant luxury serif for headings, modern clean sans-serif for body, large line spacing, breathable layout, no heavy weights except headlines. Animations: smooth, scroll-triggered, ease-in-out cubic, 0.8s–1.2s, no bounce/elastic, foreground moves faster than background for depth, calm cinematic pacing. Loader: black screen, gold 'M' monogram fade-in, gold wave line draws, text fades in, loader dissolves into hero with cross-fade/zoom-out, scroll locked until complete. Hero: full-screen cinematic background (video/motion image), dark overlay, slow zoom-in, exact text as provided, badges, CTAs, parallax, sequential fade, text fades out as next section enters. Location: all provided content, map embed, gold divider, parallax, pin pulse. Project overview: 14 acres, 212 plots, last few available, status, count-up numbers, animated cards/lines. Legal: all items, fade-in cards, gold tick animation. Plot configurations: cards for sizes, hover gold glow/lift, staggered fade. Infrastructure: full list, icons draw, text fade. Amenities: all listed, vertical-to-horizontal scroll gallery, active card enlarges, inactive dims. Gated living: all points, background lock, slow fade, zoom. Investment: all points, exact quote, word-by-word fade, gold underline. Final CTA: headline, support lines, CTAs, section rises, gold border, CTA pulse. Footer: logo, brand statement, disclaimer, gold divider, fade-out. Mobile: same cinematic logic, no horizontal scroll, sticky bottom CTA, smooth anchor jumps. Build as a cinematic scrolling property experience, not a normal website. Do not simplify or remove features. Must feel Grade-A, premium, and investment-worthy.
